release_authority: GitHub main plus explicitly approved immutable release tag; branch artifacts are candidates

version_domains.core: SemVer in architecture and changelog; Git tag only after reviewed merged release candidate
version_domains.catalog: SemVer in sparks.json, separately evolvable before a core release
version_domains.schema: Per-contract major version and validated explicit migration for incompatible changes
version_domains.data: Append-only immutable observations/revisions and reproducible snapshot manifest digests, not repository version increments per tick
version_domains.engine: Per-engine algorithm/config version, source commit SHA, input snapshot digest and point-in-time as_of
version_domains.report: Exact code revision, engine versions, input hashes/TTDs and generation timestamp

candidate_gates.requirement: Orchestration instructions and catalog approved, merged and retrievable from main
